Evaluate Adaptive COCO for a batch of spectra (cocoAdaptiveEvaluate.m)

Source: R/coco_adaptive_evaluate.R
coco_adaptive_evaluate.Rd

Evaluate Adaptive COCO for a batch of spectra (cocoAdaptiveEvaluate.m)

Usage

coco_adaptive_evaluate(
  data_power,
  data_frequency,
  n_target,
  spacing,
  pad,
  orbit9,
  sr_grid,
  method = "Pearson",
  max_frequency = NULL,
  target_model = c("coherent-nine", "phase-averaged"),
  amplitude_mode = c("four-group-area", "per-orbit", "fixed"),
  observed_p = FALSE
)

Arguments

data_power

One-sided periodograms of the data to evaluate (numeric matrix, one spectrum per column, with floor(max(pad, n_target)/2) + 1 rows on the frequency grid data_frequency); negative values are set to zero. Required, no default.

data_frequency

Frequencies of the rows of data_power, in cycles per metre (numeric vector, evenly spaced from 0). Required, no default.

n_target

Number of samples of the analysed record or window (integer); the target sinusoids are synthesised on this many points. Required, no default.

spacing

Depth sampling interval of the analysed record, in metres (numeric, > 0). Required, no default.

pad

Length (number of points) to which the record was zero-padded for the periodogram (integer); the target spectra are padded to max(pad, n_target). Required, no default.

orbit9

Astronomical target periods in kyr (numeric vector; nine distinct values are needed for amplitude_mode="four-group-area" and for the grouped weights of "fixed"). Required, no default.

sr_grid

Sedimentation rates to evaluate, in cm/kyr (numeric vector, > 0). Required, no default.

method

Correlation coefficient between the data and target spectra (character): "Pearson" or "Spearman". Default="Pearson".

max_frequency

Highest frequency of the target that enters the correlation, in cycles/kyr (numeric, must be at least max(1/orbit9)); NULL uses 1.2 * max(1/orbit9). Default=NULL.

target_model

How the target spectrum is synthesised (character): "coherent-nine" (spectrum of the sum of the sinusoids, with their interference) or "phase-averaged" (sum of the individual spectra, averaged over sine and cosine phase). Default=c("coherent-nine", "phase-averaged"), i.e. "coherent-nine".

amplitude_mode

How the target amplitudes are set (character): "four-group-area" (one amplitude per group of long eccentricity, short eccentricity, obliquity and precession, fitted to the band areas; Acycle default for Adaptive COCO/eCOCO; needs target_model="coherent-nine"), "per-orbit" (each amplitude fitted to the spectral peak at its own frequency, Acycle adaptive9a) or "fixed" (weights 1.0/0.8/0.6 from coco_fixed_target_weights). Default=c("four-group-area", "per-orbit", "fixed"), i.e. "four-group-area".

observed_p

Also compute the parametric p-value of the correlation for the first column of data_power at every rate (logical, TRUE or FALSE); used for the observed spectrum, not for the Monte Carlo spectra. FALSE returns NA p-values. Default=FALSE.
